## v0.2.2

- Add a mobile and tablet navigation that exposes every Emby library and keeps settings, requests, sync and session actions accessible on small screens.
- Improve mobile collection reliability with responsive layouts, valid poster controls, deferred artwork decoding and smaller catalog responses that omit duplicate raw metadata.
- Add an administrator-managed API key and `POST /api/external/sync` endpoint so Radarr or Sonarr can trigger an Emby catalog sync after imports.
- Let administrators select a current Radarr or Sonarr root folder before approving a request, and validate that folder against the service before submission.
- Reuse request-search posters in requester and administrator request cards.
